title: Code-mode output budgets and image helper are advertised without host enforcement
wanted_capability: Honor exec max_output_tokens and wait max_tokens in the harness host adapter, preserve cell lifecycle/error metadata outside content truncation, and forward advertised image content or make the unsupported capability explicit.
fallback_used: Explicitly select and shorten text inside cells; do not rely on the advertised output budget.
notes: Installed isolate probe with max_output_tokens=1 returned all 20000 emitted characters (20001 bytes with CLI newline). Source passes the field into ExecuteRequest but never consumes it. Wait description advertises max_tokens, absent from schema and handler. Upstream Codex 242c5ce01cd3388f7d23a87b68615b2042a04bfc implements truncation in core/src/tools/code_mode/mod.rs before adding lifecycle fields. See design/bro-harness/model-facing-tools-audit.md.
resolution_note: Addressed on fix/harness-tool-contracts: host enforces exec/wait budgets under 12KiB, preserves lifecycle handles/error/notifications, explicit unsupported image error and honest description, isolate auto-wait adapts to status prefixes and retains yielded errors. Regression suite and rebuilt isolate validate behavior.
